Nothing says it was found or where."}],"voice":1,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"It breaks character by copying the briefing headings ('News since your last bulletin', 'Already reported in your earlier bulletins') into the bulletin, and it wrongly says the sculpture was 'found'.
